<DIV class=3D"tier-3 title">
<H1 itemprop=3D"name">Asian Grilled Salmon</H1></DIV></SECTION><SECTION>
<DIV class=3D"bd">
<DIV class=3D"lead-overview">
<DIV class=3D"col18">
<DIV class=3D"avatar group">
<DIV class=3D"media">
<DIV class=3D"avatar group" itemprop=3D"author" =
itemtype=3D"http://schema.org/Person"=20
itemscope=3D"">
<H6>Recipe courtesy of <SPAN itemprop=3D"name">Ina=20
Garten</SPAN></H6></DIV></DIV></DIV></DIV>
<DIV class=3D"col12 pic collapsed"><FIGURE><A title=3D"Asian Grilled =
Salmon" =
href=3D"http://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/ina-garten/asian-grilled-salmo=
n-recipe.print.html#lightbox-recipe-image"><IMG=20
width=3D"406" height=3D"305" title=3D"Asian Grilled Salmon" =
onload=3D"pagespeed.CriticalImages.checkImageForCriticality(this);"=20
alt=3D"Asian Grilled Salmon" =
src=3D"http://foodnetwork.sndimg.com/content/dam/images/food/fullset/2011=
/5/27/0/IG0505_Asian-Grilled-Salmon_s4x3.jpg.rend.sni12col.landscape.jpeg=
"=20
pagespeed_url_hash=3D"1764759214" itemprop=3D"image"> </A> =
<FIGCAPTION>Asian Grilled=20
Salmon</FIGCAPTION></FIGURE></DIV>
<DIV class=3D"col6 info collapsed">
<DIV class=3D"cooking-times">
<DL>
  <DT class=3D"total">Total Time:</DT>
  <DD class=3D"total">34 min</DD>
  <DT>Prep:</DT>
  <DD>5 min</DD>
  <DT>Inactive:</DT>
  <DD>20 min</DD>
  <DT>Cook:</DT>
  <DD>9 min</DD></DL></DIV>
<HR>

<DIV class=3D"difficulty">
<DL>
  <DT>Yield:</DT>
  <DD>6 servings</DD></DL>
<DL>
  <DT>Level:</DT>
  <DD>Easy</DD></DL></DIV></DIV></DIV></DIV></SECTION><SECTION =
class=3D"recipe-instructions">
<DIV class=3D"bd">
<DIV class=3D"col18 ingredients">
<H6>Ingredients</H6>
<UL>
  <LI itemprop=3D"ingredients">1 side fresh salmon, boned but skin on =
(about 3=20
  pounds)</LI>
  <LI class=3D"subtitle">For the <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/marinade/index.html"=20
  debug=3D"68 76">marinade</A>:</LI>
  <LI itemprop=3D"ingredients">2 tablespoons <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/dijon-mustard/index.html"=20
  debug=3D"96 109">Dijon mustard</A></LI>
  <LI itemprop=3D"ingredients">3 tablespoons good <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/soy-sauce/index.html"=20
  debug=3D"133 142">soy sauce</A></LI>
  <LI itemprop=3D"ingredients">6 tablespoons good <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/olive-oil/index.html"=20
  debug=3D"166 175">olive oil</A></LI>
  <LI itemprop=3D"ingredients">1/2 teaspoon minced =
garlic</LI></UL></DIV>
<DIV class=3D"col18 directions" itemprop=3D"recipeInstructions">
<H6>Directions</H6>
<P>Light charcoal briquettes in a grill and brush the grilling rack with =
oil to=20
keep the salmon from sticking.</P>
<P>While the grill is heating, lay the <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/salmon/index.html"=20
debug=3D"148 154">salmon</A> skin side down on a cutting board and cut =
it=20
crosswise into 4 equal pieces. <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/whisk/index.html"=20
debug=3D"231 236">Whisk</A> together the mustard, soy sauce, olive oil, =
and <A=20
class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/garlic/index.html"=20
debug=3D"285 291">garlic</A> in a small bowl. <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/drizzle/index.html"=20
debug=3D"309 316">Drizzle</A> half of the marinade onto the salmon and =
allow it to=20
sit for 10 minutes.</P>
<P>Place the salmon skin side down on the hot grill; discard the =
marinade the=20
fish was sitting in. <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/grill/index.html"=20
debug=3D"490 495">Grill</A> for 4 to 5 minutes, depending on the =
thickness of the=20
fish. Turn carefully with a wide <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/spatula/index.html"=20
debug=3D"583 590">spatula</A> and grill for another 4 to 5 minutes. The =
salmon=20
will be slightly raw in the center, but don't worry; it will keep =
cooking as it=20
sits.</P>
<P>Transfer the fish to a flat plate, skin side down, and spoon the =
reserved=20
marinade on top. Allow the <A class=3D"crosslink" =
href=3D"http://www.foodterms.com/encyclopedia/fish/index.html"=20
debug=3D"831 835">fish</A> to rest for 10 minutes. Remove the skin and =
serve warm,=20
at room temperature, or chilled.</P>

.container footer {
	padding-bottom: 21px; font-size: 1.2rem;
}
.container footer a {
	color: rgb(28, 28, 28);
}
.container footer a:hover {
	color: rgb(255, 0, 0);
}
.container footer.row {
	background: 0px; margin-top: 28px;
}
.container footer nav {
	padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 14px; border-bottom-color: =
rgb(204, 204, 204); border-bottom-width: 1px; border-bottom-style: =
solid;
}
.container footer nav::before {
	line-height: 0; display: table; content: "";
}
.container footer nav::after {
	line-height: 0; display: table; content: "";
}
.container footer nav::after {
	clear: both;
}
.container footer .extras {
	margin-right: -1px; border-right-color: rgb(204, 204, 204); =
border-right-width: 1px; border-right-style: solid;
}
.container footer .group {
	width: 176px; margin-right: 17px; float: left;
}
.container footer :last-child.group {
	margin-right: 0px;
}
.container footer .last-menu li {
	padding: 0px 7px; margin-bottom: 1em; border-right-color: rgb(51, 51, =
51); border-right-width: 1px; border-right-style: solid; float: left;
}
.container footer .last-menu li:first-child {
	padding-left: 0px;
}
.container footer .last-menu li:last-child {
	border: 0px currentColor; border-image: none;
}
.container footer .last-menu + p {
	clear: left;
}
.container footer .last-menu li:not(.adchoices) {
	padding-top: 1px;
}
.container footer .last-menu li.adchoices span {
	vertical-align: middle;
}
.pull-right {
	float: right;
}
.pull-left {
	float: left;
}
.hide {
	display: none;
}
.show {
	display: block;
}
.invisible {
	visibility: hidden;
}
.affix {
	position: fixed;
}
.caps {
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.disabled {
	pointer-events: none;
}
.fade {
	transition:opacity 0.1s linear; opacity: 0; -webkit-transition: opacity =
.1s linear; -moz-transition: opacity .1s linear; -o-transition: opacity =
.1s linear;
}
.in.fade {
	opacity: 1;
}
.collapse {
	transition:height 0.35s; height: 0px; overflow: hidden; position: =
relative; -webkit-transition: height .35s ease; -moz-transition: height =
.35s ease; -o-transition: height .35s ease;
}
.in.collapse {
	height: auto;
}
.pattern {

255);

.is-visible {

.is-hidden {

.is-removed {

.printable {
	background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); margin-top: 28px;
}
.printable h1 {
	font-size: 44px;
}
.printable h6 {
	font-size: 32px;
}
.printable p {
	font-size: 18px;
}
.printable dt {
	padding-right: 14px; font-size: 18px;
}
.printable dd {
	font-size: 18px;
}
.printable li {
	font-size: 18px;
}
.printable article {
	padding-right: 14px; border-right-color: rgb(153, 153, 153); =
border-right-width: 1px; border-right-style: dotted;
}
.printable article section:first-child {
	margin-top: 0px;
}
.printable [role=3D'complementary'] {
	margin-left: 0px;
}
.printable [role=3D'complementary'] section {
	margin: 0px;
}
.printable ul li {
	margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.printable .tier-3 {
	margin-bottom: auto;
}
.printable .print-utility {
	padding: 0px 0px 14px; border-bottom-color: rgb(28, 28, 28); =
border-bottom-width: 5px; border-bottom-style: solid;
}
.printable .print-utility::before {
	line-height: 0; display: table; content: "";
}
.printable .print-utility::after {
	line-height: 0; display: table; content: "";
}
.printable .print-utility::after {
	clear: both;
}
.printable .print-utility .back-btn {
	color: rgb(28, 28, 28); padding-top: 12px; font-size: 1.1rem;
}
.printable .print-utility .back-btn::before {
	color: rgb(255, 0, 0); content: "\000AB\0000a";
}
.printable .print-header {
	padding: 14px 0px 28px; width: 100%; float: left;
}
.printable .print-header::before {
	line-height: 0; display: table; content: "";
}
.printable .print-header::after {
	line-height: 0; display: table; content: "";
}
.printable .print-header::after {
	clear: both;
}
.printable .print-header .print-brand {
	float: left;
}
.printable .print-header .ad-sponsored {
	padding-top: 7px;
}
.printable [role=3D'main'].container {
	box-shadow: none; -webkit-box-shadow: none; -moz-box-shadow: none;
}
.printable .container > .split.row {
	background: 0px;
}
.printable .page-break {
	text-align: center; display: block; page-break-before: always;
}
.printable .page-break hr {
	margin-bottom: 7px;
}
.printable .page-break span {
	text-transform: uppercase; font-family: "Demi Condensed Medium"; =
font-size: 1.1rem;
}
@media print
{
.row > article {
	float: none;
}
h1 {
	page-break-after: avoid;
}
h6 {
	page-break-after: avoid;
}
img {
	max-width: 100% !important;
}
.print-utility {
	display: none;
}
.page-break {
	display: none;
}
.page-break hr {
	display: none;
}
.page-break span {
	display: none;
}
.ico-wrap .ico {
	display: none;
}
[role=3D'complementary'] {
	display: none;
}
.article-body aside {
	display: none;
}
.printable {
	margin: 0px 1in;
}
.printable article {
	padding: 0px; width: 70%; border-right-color: currentColor; =
border-right-width: 0px; border-right-style: none;
}
.printable article section {
	width: 100%;
}
}

/**
* SniAds Global Configuration
*
* Maintained by Technical Ad Operations Group
*
* Last Updated: Tue May 26 16:41:10 2015 - Added adhesionRate descriptor =
value in preparation for new gallery adhesion unit release 1.2
**/

// Define SniAds namespace
(function() {
    window.SniAdsConfig =3D window.SniAdsConfig || {};
})();

/**
 * SniAds global configuration object. Maintained by Ad Operations =
Departments. Local site configuration can override
 * most values via SniAds.init(siteConfig). The library will ignore any =
settings that are not settable at the site level.
 * @namespace SniAdsConfig
 * @type {Object}
 */
SniAdsConfig =3D {
    /* DFP server to use. production|staging */

    /**
     * @property {string} env Determines which DFP network to use. =
Additional configurations are based on this. In
     * production, the Google Console is disabled and any logging or =
debugging functionality is removed.
     * @memberOf SniAdsConfig
     */
    "env" : "production",

    /**
     * Allows overriding the environment setting for a specific site =
value. Use the KVP value of site as the key. *Not the mdManager
     * value, but the value after SniAds has initialized and any value =
adjustments have occured. Sites will still need to use
     * the dfpEnv option in SniAds.init for additional environments like =
QA and Dev if they differ from the prod setting.
     *
     * If a site has set the environment in the SniAds.init call, the =
environment setting can be forced from here, by prepending the value
     * with an explamation point. However, the dfpenv url flag is not =
affected and can still be used to set the environment on a per page =
basis.
     *
     * Eg: !staging or !production
     *
     */
    "envSite": {
        "hgtv": "production",
        "door": "production",
        "grdn": "production",
        "travel": "production",
        "diy": "production"
    },

    /**
     * If true, DFP will not count impressions. Useful for testing.
     * @todo Not implemented yet.
     */
    "noCount": false,

    /**
     * If true, the hierarchy will use the section placeholders (l1o, =
l2o, l3o, l4o, l5o) to fill out a complete hierarchy. By default, the ad =
unit will
     * terminate at the last available section.
     */
    "fillPartialHierarchy": false,

    /**
    * An array of any values that should be removed from any key values =
before slots are created. (ie Paula Deen)
    * Values will be replaced with jjydnat and have house ads targeted =
to it.
    * *** NOTE *** THIS IS CURRENTLY DISABLED ****
    **/
    "restrictedValues": ["paula dean", "pauladean", "paula_dean"],

    /**
     * Array of all key-values we are interested in for custom =
targeting. Some sites have a ton of data so we must limit what we use to =
a subset to avoid maxing out the ad call. The max character limit for a =
DFP ad url is 2,000 characters. Keys are case-insensitive.
     */
    "targetingKeys": [
        "pagetype",
        "uniqueid",
        "topic",
        "keyterm",
        "adkey1",
        "talentName",
        "showName",
        "keyword",
        "contenttag1",
        "contenttag2",
        "referrer",
        "category",
        "photocount",
        "vgncontent",
        "show_abbr",
        "sniads_regression_test",
        "ing",
        "scripps160",
        "scripps250",
        "scripps600",
        "scripps728",
        "scripps320",
        "cs_debug",
        "subsection",
        "subsection1",
        "subsection2",
        "subsctn1",
        "subsctn2",
        "url",
        "source",
        "livingsource",
        "orntn",
        "version",
        "sbi_apoc",
        "sbi_size",
        "glist",
        "mcid",
        "aam_fw"
    ],

    /**
     * Array of the flags to use from Criteo.
     */
    "criteoFlags": ["scripps160", "scripps250", "scripps600", =
"scripps728", "scripps320"],

    /**
     * Array of dynamic key values to use in targeting. These are single =
key values that contain multiple values that are parsed into individual =
kvps.
     * Example: dimensionvalues
     */
    "dynamicTargetSets": ["dimensionvalues"],

    /**
     * An array of cookies to read into KVP. If you want them to be =
targeted, set it in the targetingKeys array also.
     */
    "cookies": ["aam_fw", "AMCV_BC501253513148ED0A490D45@AdobeOrg"],

    /**
     * Some sites handle multi word value differently. For DFP they must =
be converted to array. Set the split character for each site below.
     * As most sites use a space, that is the default. As a result, only =
sites not using spaces must be set here, but you may add all if you =
want.
     * While care has been taken to work out of the box, this allows =
control if needed.
     * When setting, key must match site key value. Eg: Food.com =3D =
foodcom
     */
    "keySettings": {
        "keytermSplit": {
            "foodcom": "-"
        },
        // The following allows overridding the key used for DFP keys. =
For example, if a site uses pageSearchTerms instead of keyterm, you can =
override the keyterm key to use the value of pageSearchTerms. NOTE: If =
you set a override, and the value does not exists, a blank value will be =
used. It will NOT revert to tryng the default.
        // DO NOT REMOVE ANY OF THESE
        // Ex: { "food": "newkey"} // use newkey instead of default key
        "override_pagetype": {},
        "override_adkey1": {},
        "override_keywords": {},
        "override_topic": {},
        "override_talentname": {},
        "override_showname": {},
        "override_uniqueid": {}
    },

     * DFP custom targeting values may not contain the following =
characters. During init, these are stripped out.
     */
    "invalidChars": "#\",*.()=3D+<>[]| ",

     * These charcters are "safe", but must be encoded before being use =
in DFP targeting.
     */
    "encodeChars": "$-_.",

    "gptSettings": {
        "collapseEmptyDivs": true,
        "singleRequestMode": true,
        "centerAds": true
